note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 against HEAD 5c2cb2199f (independent judge, after ebae55f243, ea3bab5f48, a965d7c0d4). Downgraded from enforced. Section 2.9: "When the responder chooses a subset of the traffic proposed by the initiator, it narrows the Traffic Selectors to some subset of the initiator's proposal (provided the set does not become the null set)." DEFECT at the producer: a965d7c0d4 makes narrowChildSelectors call substituteVirtualIP (cp.go) before narrowSelectors, and substituteVirtualIP replaces EVERY proposed TSi selector of a pool-bound peer with the lease /32 without checking that the proposed selector contains the lease. narrowSelectors, floorWithinProposal and closedSubset then judge the substituted list, not the peer's proposal, so the guarantee "Every returned selector is a subset of some proposed selector" no longer holds. Observed by an overlay probe (scratch, not committed) at HEAD: pool 10.10.0.0/29, lease 10.10.0.1, proposal TSi 192.0.2.50/32, TSr 0.0.0.0/0: fresh Child SA answers TSi 10.10.0.1/32 with err nil; rekey with floor 10.10.0.1/32 <-> 0.0.0.0/0 answers the floor with err nil, although the proposal covers no floor pair (Section 2.9 forbids the wider-than-proposal answer and Section 2.9.2 forbids the narrower one, so TS_UNACCEPTABLE is the only legal answer, as narrowChildSelectors' own comment says). The committed untagged TestCreateChildUsesLease (proposes 10.1.2.3/32, requires the lease) and TestRemoteSelectorIsLease (AC-5) assert this widening as intended behaviour. The tagged tests still pass and still assert the subset rule on the policy path (TestResponderNarrowsBothSelectorsToPolicy, TestTSUnacceptableIsSentWhenNothingIsAcceptable, TestRFC7296RekeyFloorIsAnsweredOnlyInsideTheProposal, TestRFC7296ResponderAnswersOnlyCombinationsItChose, TestChildRekeyInitiatorInstallsTheAnsweredSelectors; discrimination records on floorWithinProposal, intersectPair, intersectNet, narrowChildSelectors closedSubset call: none stale; four carriers' claims unproven), but none drives a pool-bound peer, so all stay green while the producer answers outside the proposal: weak. Fix: in substituteVirtualIP keep the lease for a proposed selector only when that selector contains the lease host (containsNet) and answer TS_UNACCEPTABLE when none does, so the substituted list is a subset of the proposal; tag a pool-bound negative (proposal not containing the lease draws TS_UNACCEPTABLE, fresh and rekey) and a positive (0.0.0.0/0 proposal answered with the lease). TestCreateChildUsesLease and TestRemoteSelectorIsLease encode the violation and owe a /ze-test-judge-approved correction. ebae55f243/ea3bab5f48 (mixed-family refusal in crossPairs and acceptablePairs, empty-subset guard, closedSubset doc) only drop combinations that match no packet and so never widen: no finding there.
